caption:
Send this to the one who ran at full speed all of 2026 🔥

2026 is Bing Wu, the Yang Fire Horse: the sun at full speed. 2027 is Ding Wei, the Yin Fire Goat: the same fire, turned into lamplight. Warmer, steadier, closer to home. The Horse and the Goat are one of the zodiac's classic pairs, so 2027 tends to finish what 2026 started.

Where does that fire land in your own chart? Get your free chart at skyandseason.com (link in bio), open Calendar, go to February 2027 and see your 2027 mark: Good, Steady or Care.
